profile.summary: mcollina is a senior Node.js backend engineer with deep expertise in Fastify, specializing in high-performance HTTP server architecture, middleware design, and asynchronous JavaScript patterns. Their contributions focus on performance optimizations (e.g., reducing request overhead, improving serialization throughput), HTTP standards compliance (content-type validation, multipart/form-data handling), and Node.js version compatibility. The developer demonstrates strong skills in technical documentation, benchmarking, and collaborative code review, making them a key contributor to Fastify's core framework.
